name: Banseiki Sengoku calendar: 1534 start and 1535 after three turns

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); local calendar=GameConfiguration.GetCalendarType(); if calendar~='CALENDAR_STANDARD_FROM_START_ERA' and calendar~=DB.MakeHash('CALENDAR_STANDARD_FROM_START_ERA') then error('wrong calendar: '..tostring(calendar)) end; local era=g_GameParameters.Parameters.GameStartEra; if not era or not era.Values or #era.Values~=1 then error('start era must offer exactly one value') end; local ev=era.Values[1].Value; if ev~='ERA_ANCIENT' and ev~=DB.MakeHash('ERA_ANCIENT') then error('wrong start era: '..tostring(ev)) end; HideGameSetup(); return 'start-era calendar selected; only ERA_ANCIENT offered'

if not GameCapabilities.HasCapability('CAPABILITY_DISPLAY_NORMALIZED_TURN') then error('turn display not normalized') end; local t=tostring(Controls.Turns:GetText()); if t~='1' and not t:match('^1/') then error('top panel turn is '..t) end; return 'top panel turn '..t

if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; if GameInfo.StartEras['ERA_ANCIENT'].Year~=1534 then error('wrong start year') end; local turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); if turn~=GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() then error('not at start turn') end; local date=Calendar.MakeYearStr(turn); if not string.find(date,'1534',1,true) or string.find(date,'4000',1,true) then error('wrong start date: '..tostring(date)) end; return 'start date='..date

local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; local s=nil; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetType()==GameInfo.Units['UNIT_SETTLER'].Index then s=u; break end end; if not s then error('missing settler') end; UnitManager.RequestOperation(s,UnitOperationTypes.FOUND_CITY); return 'capital requested'

local turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); if turn-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()~=3 then error('unexpected elapsed turns: '..tostring(turn)) end; local date=Calendar.MakeYearStr(turn); if not string.find(date,'1535',1,true) then error('wrong date after three turns: '..tostring(date)) end; return 'after three turns date='..date
